summary: A five-star rating display, like you'd see for reviews, that can also be made clickable to set a rating.
description: Renders five stars (empty, half, or full) derived from a numeric rating rounded to the nearest half. When selectable is set, clicking a star updates the rating and dispatches a select event with the new rating in its detail.

attributes.name: rating
attributes.description: The rating out of 5. Rounded to the nearest half to decide each star's fill state.

attributes.name: selectable
attributes.description: Whether the stars can be clicked to set a new rating.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Not rendered directly; when truthy (or when selectable is true) it suppresses the component's default localized "rating out of 5" label, on the assumption a real accessible name is supplied elsewhere.

events.name: select
events.description: CustomEvent dispatched (detail: { rating }) when a star is clicked and selectable is true.

methods.name: getStars
methods.description: Returns the current five-item array of { rating, fill } used to render each star ('full' | 'half' | 'empty').

methods.name: getStarElementRating
methods.description: Reads the rating value off a given star element's rating attribute.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Click handler for an individual star; updates rating and dispatches select when selectable is true.
